proposed_correction_contract: Read the actual creation token TokenOwner with bounded buffer/valid SID; require exact LocalSystem S-1-5-18 or Builtin Administrators S-1-5-32-544. Reject any other/unknown owner. Use the effective creation token or explicitly reject thread impersonation; do not silently substitute an unrelated token.

Use that validated owner, keep primary group Builtin Administrators and existing PG_ACCESS = FWPM_ACTRL_READ | FWPM_ACTRL_ADD_LINK | READ_CONTROL | DELETE. Do not add WRITE_DAC, WRITE_OWNER, generic-all or new principals.

Build a protected exact three-ACE DACL: first explicit deny OWNER RIGHTS S-1-3-4 for WRITE_DAC|WRITE_OWNER (0x000c0000), then the existing explicit SYSTEM and Builtin Administrators PG_ACCESS allows. Flags remain zero and exact SID/mask/type/size/count/order must be read back for all five owned objects.

Use SDK WinCreatorOwnerRightsSid (71), not a nonexistent WinOwnerRightsSid. Preserve sticky poison, no fallback/no privilege enabling, transaction/readback, fresh-owner/retained-handle and cleanup-authority rules. Unknown/error/mismatch must refuse before launching.
Retain actual001 failure and orphan reservations unchanged. A new attempt must create fresh identity; no adoption, removal or reuse of actual001 state.

protection_assessment.supported_design_inference: A valid token-owner restriction avoids the demonstrated unauthorized-owner request without broadening the explicit allow ACL. OWNER RIGHTS makes owner rights subject to the DACL; the explicit deny covers DACL/owner mutation while PG_ACCESS still provides needed explicit read/link/delete rights to the trusted host principals. This addresses the implicit-owner WRITE_DAC route; no proven working hardcoded-SYSTEM baseline exists because actual001 failed to arm.
